01 · Launch

A coin in one click.
For nothing.

Name it, symbol it, ship it. Deploying costs $0 — you pay gas in USDC and nothing else. Your coin trades instantly on a bonding curve, with no liquidity to raise and no code to write. Creator tokens stay locked for 30 days after graduation, so nobody dumps on you.

02
02 · Trade

Real dollars.
Real price discovery.

Every coin is priced in USDC from the first trade. Buy early on the curve, ride it to the $1,500 graduation, then the liquidity moves on-chain forever. Trading costs 1%, and 80% of that goes to whoever created the coin.

03 · Predict

Will it graduate?
Put money on it.

Every launch spawns a market. Stake USDC on YES or NO — winners split the pot. No oracle, no judge: the blockchain itself settles the bet the moment a coin graduates.
